nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Teca Plumping Ampoule

avis.titre: reasonably priced, works wellreasonably priced, works well
avis.texte: This is a good hydrating and plumping serum, and I think the product story holds together rather well. The main promise here is hydration and a plumper, dewier look, and the formula supports that. It has glycerin, niacinamide, methylpropanediol, sodium hyaluronate, centella asiatica extract, methyl gluceth-20, butylene glycol, trehalose, beta-glucan, polyglutamic acid, and other supportive skin-conditioning ingredients. I do not have access to exact percentages, but the placement of the ingredients makes the hydration and plumping angle believable. The centella angle also feels fair to me. I do not read this as a serum where centella is necessarily the main performance driver. The immediate effect seems more likely to come from the humectants and film-forming hydration system. But centella asiatica extract is present, along with centella-related components like madecassoside, asiaticoside, asiatic acid, and madecassic acid. So the Madagascar Centella branding does not feel empty or purely decorative. It feels like a real part of the formula, even if the serum is still mainly a plumping hydration product. In use, this has more tack than I expected. It goes on easily, but tack appears pretty quickly after application and lingers for a while. Within about 5 minutes, it is otherwise fully dry and ready for a finishing cream, but there is still a little residual tack. With my oily skin, this works best in a more minimal routine, mostly because tack can build up too much otherwise.

I have eczema and roscea. This unfortunately left my face tight with a few hives. I liked the texture. I love another serum from this brand so im assuming it could be one of the fruit extracts that irritated me. Its not a bad product but if u have reactive skin i would test patch.

avis.titre: I am very pleased with this serum for my sensitive skin.I am very pleased with this serum for my sensitive skin.
avis.texte: I ordered the SKIN1004 Hyalu TECA Plumping Ampoule, Hydrating Hyaluronic Acid Serum with Soothing Centella & Ceramide, and Peptides. I ordered this Korean Skincare product because of the great ingredient list and because it appeared to be a good choice for my sensitive skin. I have not been disappointed and I feel like this product has good value. This serum comes in a pretty light purple bottle with dropper and contains 1.69 fl.oz / 50ml of product. The white-colored serum is extremely lightweight and has a thin, watery texture that looks a bit milky. It is not greasy. I find it to be a little sticky when first applied but the stickiness goes away very quickly. It absorbs rapidly and is very hydrating. Because this absorbs so quickly, if you have really dry skin, you may need to apply a few layers to see results. This is a very clean formula with solid ingredients. It is marketed as a skin plumping treatment that helps improve skin elasticity and calm sensitive skin and reduce redness. This was appealing to me as I often get skin redness and irritation. This formula is free of synthetic fragrance and harsh ingredients and those things are very important to me. I have been using this formula for about two weeks now and I feel like my skin has already shown some improvements in smoothness and decreased redness and irritation. It's probably too soon to see any of the longer term effects like improvements in firming or elasticity. It has definitely become a favorite serum for me
Super calming and moisturizing, great value for price, there hasn't been a single product they've made I haven't like

avis.titre: No Noticeable Plumping, but My Skin Feels Softer and Looks Fresher
avis.texte: I have been using this SKIN1004 ampoule for almost a month, and I cannot say I have seen any visible plumping. None. My skin does feel noticeably softer, though, and it has a fresher, more hydrated look…as fresh as skin in its 50s can reasonably be expected to look, anyway. The formula viscosity is very thin and spreads beautifully. It feels almost silky while I am smoothing it over my skin, although it does take a little while to absorb. As it dries, it leaves some slight tackiness behind, but that fades after a bit and has not caused any problems under my other skincare products. The scent is very, very faint and the scent profile comes across as really clean and refreshing to me. The 50 ml bottle is generously sized compared with many similar serums and ampoules and the current listed price of $19 at the time of my review is a really good value. So, plumping? Not for me. But as a soothing, moisturizing serum that leaves my skin softer and looking a little more alive, it has earned a place in my skin care routine.

avis.titre: Terrific ALL IN ONE deeply hydrating & soothing serum that gives my skin a terrific glow!
avis.texte: If I had to limit myself to one serum a day this would be a strong contender ( and I have a lot of skincare!) In fact I have an upcoming vacation and I do believe this will win out as the one I will be taking with me as this is a milky serum that meets so many of my skins needs. I am 42yo with combo skin that has slight tendencies for rosacea, reactivity and acne so this is no small feat. This Centella Hyalu-TECA plumping ampoule is a thinner milky serum that has a slightly silky yet very lightweight texture. It absorbs effortlessly into my skin offering immediate soothing and hydration. It has a dewy finish that leaves my skin impressively silky soft for a serum. The intense hydration this provides plumps my skin, noticeably helping improve my skins texture and radiance. It also layers really well with my other skincare steps and sunscreen without creating any texture or pilling issues and not causing any irritation. Having reactive tendencies I always look closely at ingredient profiles. While this is a longer one, I only see so much goodness here and nothing of concern to my skin (no fragrance, alcohol nor other common irritants other than the small amount of citric acid listed very close to the bottom). This milky serum DOES contain nearly all of my favorites for barrier support and assistance with my rosacea related redness & reactivity (highly concentrated Centella + Madecassoside, Asiaticoside, Madecassic Acid, Beta glucan, Ceramide NP, Niacinamide... ) but also a grea

I've used several products from SKIN1004 over the years, so I already had high expectations for this ampoule, and it definitely didn't disappoint. This brand has consistently worked well for my skin, and this has quickly become another favorite. The texture is lightweight, silky, and absorbs beautifully without leaving behind any sticky or greasy feeling. My skin immediately feels more hydrated, softer, and looks noticeably healthier after I apply it. I also really like the ingredient combination. It contains hyaluronic acid for hydration, centella to help soothe the skin, ceramides to support the skin barrier, and peptides, which are one of my favorite skincare ingredients because I love products that focus on keeping skin looking firm and healthy. It layers nicely with the rest of my routine and sits well under moisturizer without pilling. If you're already a fan of Korean skincare or the SKIN1004 brand in general, I don't think you'll be disappointed with this one. It's another product from them that my skin has been loving.

I am 46 and have very dry, aging skin. I love using new Korean skincare products to find the ones that work best for my skin. Skin1004 is a solid brand that I always enjoy and recently ordered their Hyalu TECA Plumping Ampould. This is a 1.69 ounce dropper top bottle of serum that is designed to be deeply hydrating, support the skin barrier, firm, plump, and leave skin glowy. It’s a pretty robust serum! It is formulated with key ingredients like Sodium Hyaluronate, CICA, TECA, Multi-Collagen, Peptides, Glutathione, and Ceramide. I appreciate that the ingredients are so skin friendly. This has a nice, slippery serum consistency and no real notable scent. It only takes a few drops to massage it into my whole face and absorbs at a nice pace. The level of hydration and bounce I feel after a few uses is quite impressive. I love the bit of glow I am seeing and imagine that will get even better with further use. So far, my skin is loving it and I have had no adverse reactions. The quality of the ingredients and effectiveness I am seeing so far make this seem like it’s a great value for the very reasonable price and I am liking it a lot!

I ordered this because my skin has really been struggling with the dry Arizona heat and I’ve been on a bit of a Korean skincare kick lately. I’ve been loving so many of the Korean beauty products I’ve tried and this serum has been another great addition to my routine. It feels lightweight when I put it on but it gives my skin a nice boost of hydration and leaves it feeling soft. My skin has a healthy glow without feeling greasy. I also love that it layers well with my moisturizer and doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin. Living in Arizona, I’m always looking for products that help my skin hold onto moisture and this one has fit right into my daily routine. Great price for a great serum!!

avis.titre: Gave my reactive skin exactly what it needed!  Even my rosacea loves this!
avis.texte: Hello, glowy skin! Wow! This SKIN1004 Hyalu TECA ampoule delivers! This is an unscented, really lightweight serum- it has the nice consistency of a thinner gel. This spreads onto my skin so easily and smoothly that you don't need much at all to cover your entire face. This is very moisturizing and definitely gives your skin a plumped, healthy look while also giving you the glow it claims to give. I love the color of this serum, too! It's a clear, thin consistency and super gentle. I have reactive skin and rosacea, and this did everything to nurture my skin with its high quality, soothing ingredients. This absorbs really fast when I pat it in and doesn't leave any residue or sticky/greasy feeling. This is such a great value for your money considering how well it works and how little you need- just order it and your skin will thank you. Repeatedly!
